Heard on I.A.No.4115/2024, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of the Code of
Criminal Procedure 1973, for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of sole appellant
Atul Kori .

The appellant was convicted for the offence punishable under Section 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and Section 67-B(B) of IT Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, with default stipulations.

The appellant has also been convicted under Sections 376(1) and 376(2)(n) of IPC, and Section 3 r/w Section 4 of POCSO Act but no separate sentence has been awarded under these sections vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 22.12.2023 passed in S.C. No.95/2022 by the Third Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, Sagar.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, Sagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This first application for seeking suspension of sentence has been argued on the grounds that this is a matter of consensual relationship where the prosecutrix herself has claimed that there were repeated episodes of having physical relationship; there was a delay of almost nine months in lodging the FIR; the date of birth of prosecutrix was not proved through reliable evidence; Mahesh Singh Thakur (P.W.7) has admitted that the entry in scholar register was not made by him; the father of prosecutrix, who got her name registered in school, has passed 2 CRA-2249-2024 away and the mother of prosecutrix (P.W.2) has not been able to prove her date of birth convincingly.
It has also been submitted that the video/ photographs allegedly sent by appellant were not having any obscene contents.
Based on these facts, a request has been made to allow the application.

The application has been opposed by the State on the ground that in this case involving sexual abuse of a minor and sending photographs of showing her in compromising state to her relatives, the appellant cannot be shown any leniency.

sentences.text: Counsel for the parties have been heard and the record has been perused.
Taking all these facts into consideration and without commenting on merits of the case, I.A. under consideration is allowed .

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 30.06.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
Accordingly, the aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of .
List for final hearing in due course.
